    36	  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
    37	  Object.freeze(v);
    38	  var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
    39	  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) deepFreeze(v[names[i]]);

   369	  // other than 'length' or a canonical numeric index (no Symbol keys, no string names,
   370	  // no negative / fractional / leading-zero indices). The walk indexes BY index, not by
   371	  // getOwnPropertyNames enumeration order, so a hostile array that puts named own keys
   372	  // first cannot smuggle a hole past the cap check.
   373	  function _snapshotArrayShape(a, invalidCode) {
   374	    if (!_isPlainArray(a)) {

   376	    }

   389	    // non-enumerable / accessor / non-data descriptors on indices.
   390	    var names;

   412	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + nm };

   459	  // outcomeId is deterministic from (experimentId, changeId). No clock leak.
   460	  function _hash32(s) {
   461	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   462	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   463	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   464	      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
   465	      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
   466	    }
   467	    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
   468	  }
   469	  function _fnv2(s) {
   470	    var slen = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   471	    return _hash32(s) + _hash32(s + '|' + slen);
   472	  }
   473	  function _outcomeId(experimentId, changeId) {
   474	    return 'outcome_' + _fnv2('outcome|' + experimentId + '|' + changeId);
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  // ---------- Main entry: classifyOutcome -----------------------------------------------------
   478	  /**
   479	   * classifyOutcome(input, opts) — produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope.
   480	   *
   481	   * Ordered steps (clock MUST NOT fire before Step 9):
   482	   *   0.  intrinsic integrity (captures + contract surfaces still frozen)
   483	   *   1.  input wrapper descriptor snapshot (closed keys; symbol/accessor/proxy rejected)
   484	   *   2.  experiment frozen + E1 shape validation
   485	   *   3.  appliedChange snapshot + shape
   486	   *   4.  followUp snapshot + shape
   487	   *   5.  observation snapshot + shape
   488	   *   6.  controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 shape
   489	   *   7.  opts snapshot
   490	   *   8.  identity binding (status=applied, sourceExperimentId match, parentCaseId match)
   491	   *   9.  resolve freshness reference time (clock at most once)
   492	   *   10. freshness check on experiment.createdAt + appliedChange.appliedAt
   493	   *   11. comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence)
   494	   *   12. control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders precedence)
   495	   *   13. data-quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade
   496	   *   14. compose outcome
   497	   *   15. validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape
   498	   *   16. envelope byte cap
   499	   *   17. deep-freeze + register
   500	   */
   501	  function classifyOutcome(inputIn, optsIn) {
   502	    try {
   503	      // ---- Step 0: intrinsic integrity ----------------------------------------------------
   504	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
   505	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected at entry');
   506	      }
   507	
   508	      // ---- Step 1: input wrapper descriptor snapshot -------------------------------------
   509	      var inSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputIn, INPUT_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, { requireFrozen: false });
   510	      if (inSnapR.valid !== true) {
   511	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(inSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: inSnapR.detail });
   512	      }
   513	      var inputSnap = inSnapR.snapshot;
   514	
   515	      // ---- Step 2: experiment shape validation -------------------------------------------
   516	      // The Experiment must be deep-frozen (immutability) AND pass the E1 contract.
   517	      if (!_isFrozenSafe(inputSnap.experiment)) {
   518	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment not deep-frozen' });
   519	      }
   520	      var expCheck = EXP.validateExperimentShape(inputSnap.experiment);
   521	      if (expCheck.valid !== true) {
   522	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(
   523	          expCheck.reasonCodes ? expCheck.reasonCodes.slice() : [CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID],
   524	          { detail: 'experiment shape invalid' }
   525	        );
   526	      }
   527	      var experiment = inputSnap.experiment;
   528	
   529	      // ---- Step 3: appliedChange snapshot + shape ----------------------------------------
   530	      var acSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.appliedChange, APPLIED_CHANGE_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   531	      if (acSnapR.valid !== true) {
   532	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(acSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'appliedChange: ' + acSnapR.detail });
   533	      }
   534	      var appliedChange = acSnapR.snapshot;
   535	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.changeId)) {
   536	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.changeId invalid' });
   537	      }
   538	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.sourceExperimentId)) {
   539	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.sourceExperimentId invalid' });
   540	      }
   541	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(appliedChange.appliedAt) || _isoToMs(appliedChange.appliedAt) === null) {
   542	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.appliedAt invalid' });
   543	      }
   544	
   545	      // ---- Step 4: followUp snapshot + shape ---------------------------------------------
   546	      var fuSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.followUp, FOLLOWUP_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   547	      if (fuSnapR.valid !== true) {
   548	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(fuSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'followUp: ' + fuSnapR.detail });
   549	      }
   550	      var followUp = fuSnapR.snapshot;
   551	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.followUpCaseId)) {
   552	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.followUpCaseId invalid' });
   553	      }
   554	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.parentCaseId)) {
   555	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_PARENT_MISSING], { detail: 'followUp.parentCaseId invalid' });
   556	      }
   557	      if (followUp.parentCaseId === followUp.followUpCaseId) {
   558	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'follow-up case is self-link' });
   559	      }
   560	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.sessionId)) {
   561	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.sessionId invalid' });
   562	      }
   563	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.parentSessionId)) {
   564	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.parentSessionId invalid' });
   565	      }
   566	      if (!_isBool(followUp.hasExplicitReference)) {
   567	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.hasExplicitReference not bool' });
   568	      }
   569	      if (!_isFiniteNumber(followUp.comparabilityScore) || followUp.comparabilityScore < 0 || followUp.comparabilityScore > 1) {
   570	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT], { detail: 'followUp.comparabilityScore out of [0,1]' });
   571	      }
   572	
   573	      // ---- Step 5: observation snapshot + shape ------------------------------------------
   574	      var obsSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.observation, OBSERVATION_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   575	      if (obsSnapR.valid !== true) {
   576	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(obsSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'observation: ' + obsSnapR.detail });
   577	      }
   578	      var observation = obsSnapR.snapshot;
   579	      // observedDirection: enum OR null
   580	      if (observation.observedDirection !== null && DIRECTION_ALLOWED.indexOf(observation.observedDirection) === -1) {
   581	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'observation.observedDirection invalid' });
   582	      }
   583	      // observedMagnitude: finite OR null
   584	      if (observation.observedMagnitude !== null && !_isFiniteNumber(observation.observedMagnitude)) {
   585	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'observation.observedMagnitude invalid' });
   586	      }
   587	      // driverFeedback: STRICT i18n key (dotted lower_snake_case, 2..6 segments, ≤128 chars)
   588	      // OR null. Codex E3-R1-02 closure: a non-empty-string check alone permits free-text
   589	      // blame / causation / paths to be laundered into the outcome envelope. The strict
   590	      // grammar rejects spaces, slashes, capital letters, and any character outside
   591	      // [a-z0-9._], blocking blame phrasing ("driver error because…") and path leakage
   592	      // ("/Users/…", "..\\etc\\…") at the contract boundary.
   593	      if (observation.driverFeedback !== null && !_i18nKeyOk(observation.driverFeedback)) {
   594	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_DRIVER_FEEDBACK_INVALID], { detail: 'driverFeedback not a strict i18n key' });
   595	      }
   596	      // dataQualityIssues / sideEffects / contradictingEvidenceIds / supportingEvidenceIds — bounded plain arrays.
   597	      var dqiR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.dataQualityIssues, CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID);
   598	      if (dqiR.valid !== true) {
   599	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(dqiR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'dataQualityIssues: ' + dqiR.detail });
   600	      }
   601	      var dataQualityIssues = dqiR.snapshot;
   602	      for (var qi = 0; qi < dataQualityIssues.length; qi++) {
   603	        if (!_nonEmptyStr(dataQualityIssues[qi])) {
   604	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID], { detail: 'dataQualityIssues[' + qi + '] not non-empty string' });
   605	        }
   606	      }
   607	      var seR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.sideEffects, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   608	      if (seR.valid !== true) {
   609	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(seR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'sideEffects: ' + seR.detail });
   610	      }
   611	      var sideEffects = seR.snapshot;
   612	      // Each side-effect must be a plain { i18nKey, params } object.
   613	      // Codex E3-R2-01 closure: i18nKey MUST pass the strict i18n grammar — same gate as
   614	      // driverFeedback — so free-text / blame / causation / path laundering through the
   615	      // side-effect surface is impossible.
   616	      // Codex E3-R2-02 closure: params is restricted to a CLOSED primitive allowlist
   617	      // (null OR plain object whose every value is a finite number / boolean / null).
   618	      // String values are FORBIDDEN to eliminate any free-text laundering vector. i18n
   619	      // substitution numerics (thresholds, magnitudes) remain expressible.
   620	      var SE_KEYS_FROZEN = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(['i18nKey', 'params']);

   235	      if (!_wsHas(_authoritativeOutcomes, candidate)) return false;

   237	      if (candidate.schemaVersion !== OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION) return false;
   238	      if (typeof candidate.outcomeId !== 'string') return false;
   239	      if (typeof candidate.experimentId !== 'string') return false;
   240	      if (typeof candidate['class'] !== 'string') return false;
   241	      if (!_isArraySafe(candidate.confounders)) return false;
   242	      if (!_isArraySafe(candidate.limitations)) return false;
   243	      return true;
   244	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   245	  }
   246	
   247	  // ---------- Structural helpers --------------------------------------------------------------
   248	  function _isOriginalPlainObject(v) {
   249	    try {
   250	      if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object' || _CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(v)) return false;
   251	      var p = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_PROTO(v);
   252	      return p === Object.prototype || p === null;
   253	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   254	  }
   255	  function _isPlainArray(v) {
   256	    try {
   257	      if (!_CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(v)) return false;
   258	      var p = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_PROTO(v);
   259	      return p === Array.prototype;
   260	    } catch (e) { return false; }

   775	// U1 — E3-R1-01: Object.create rebind cannot bypass confounder check
   776	(function () {
   777	  // Reproducer: declare a control variable in experiment, supply ZERO observations,
   778	  // then rebind ambient Object.create to a function that returns a populated object.
   779	  // BEFORE closure: classifier's `observedCvByName = Object.create(null)` would receive
   780	  // the populated object → presence check passes → missing CV not detected → confirmed.
   781	  // AFTER closure: captured Object.create is used + descriptor-only membership check.
   782	  var emptyCvInput = makeInput({ controlVariableObservations: [] });
   783	  var realObjectCreate = Object.create;
   784	  var classBefore = null, classAfter = null;
   785	  try {
   786	    classBefore = (function () {
   787	      var r = CL.classifyOutcome(emptyCvInput, { clock: fixedClock() });
   788	      return r.valid === true ? r.outcome['class'] : ('BLOCKED:' + (r.reasonCodes || []).join(','));
   789	    })();
   790	    // Hostile rebind: any new Object.create() returns a synthesized membership map.
   791	    Object.create = function () {
   792	      var fakeSet = {};

   794	        value: true, writable: false, enumerable: true, configurable: false,
   795	      });

   797	    };

   799	      var r = CL.classifyOutcome(emptyCvInput, { clock: fixedClock() });
   800	      return r.valid === true ? r.outcome['class'] : ('BLOCKED:' + (r.reasonCodes || []).join(','));
   801	    })();
   802	  } finally {
   803	    Object.create = realObjectCreate;
   804	  }
   805	  chk('U1: Object.create rebind cannot bypass missing-CV detection',
   806	    classBefore === 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders'
   807	      && classAfter === 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders',
